headline: Auto Industry Estimates Section 232 Tariff Could Be Less Than 5%
summary: The Mexican auto industry estimates the Section 232 tariff could fall below 5%. Mexico is reportedly close to a deal with the United States to reduce auto sector tariffs, which could be announced in December.
why: Mexico is a major auto exporter to the United States, so changes to Section 232 tariffs directly affect the margins and export volumes of automakers and suppliers.
original_headline: Industria automotriz estima que el arancel de la 232 podría ser menor al 5%
